purpose: Prevent fragile bespoke approximations. Each candidate's reference implementation must be cross-checked against the standard established engine appropriate to its mechanism class. A second internal implementation is NOT independent verification (Article XXVI).

verification_reference_cases: svFSI public test repository — patient-specific aortic flow benchmark
FDA nozzle benchmark (flow-induced pressure drop, published experimental data)
Carotid bifurcation benchmark (patient-specific, published clinical measurements)

frozen_tolerance_template.reference_case: FDA nozzle benchmark, nominal flow 5 L/min

verification_reference_cases: FEBio verification suite — analytical solutions for compression/torsion/contact
Hyperelastic uniaxial tension benchmark (Ogden, Mooney-Rivlin analytical)

verification_reference_cases: COPASI test suite — published Kholodenko MAPK cascade benchmark

engines.name: MCell

engines.name: MCX (Monte Carlo eXtreme)

frozen_tolerance_template.reference_case: Published NIR 940nm transmission through 5mm tissue phantom

engines.R309_special_mandate: Resolve R308 P-16 disagreement: diffusion approximation vs. Kubelka–Munk differ 60–70%. MCX is the Monte Carlo tiebreaker. PyTissueOptics (SIM_PYTISSOPT) is the independent implementation. Comparison to published 940nm measurements is the ground truth.

use_for: Not a primary solver (MCX is primary for tissue optics)
verification_reference_cases: Cross-validation against MCX (within 5% for identical phantom)

frozen_tolerance_template.reference_case: Identical phantom as MCX run, 940nm, 5mm tissue

engines.name: scikit-learn + reproducible seed protocol
verification_reference_cases: Published classification benchmarks (MNIST, Iris, Breast Cancer Wisconsin)
k-fold cross-validation (k=5 or k=10) with frozen seed

frozen_tolerance_template.reference_case: k-fold CV on published dataset, same seed

engines.seed_protocol: All training/inference runs use frozen seeds declared in preregistration. Cross-validation folds declared BEFORE result observation (Article VIII).

deviation_protocol.description: If a candidate's mechanism does not fit any of the above classes, the deviation must be declared and justified in writing.
deviation_protocol.approval_required: Constitutional review (Article XXXVI §6: 'must declare the closest external reference and justify the deviation in writing')

transitions.VERIFICATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED → VERIFICATIO: Engine selected from registry, tolerance declared, reference case cited, timestamp recorded.
transitions.VERIFICATION_PREREGISTERED → VERIFICATIO: Independent solver invoked. Cannot return to NOT_ATTEMPTED.
transitions.VERIFICATION_RUNNING → MODEL_VERIFIED: Comparison within frozen tolerance. Raw outputs preserved.
transitions.VERIFICATION_RUNNING → MODEL_DISAGREEMEN: Comparison outside tolerance. AI investigates root cause (implementation bug, model assumption, parameter mismatch, genuine physics gap).
transitions.MODEL_DISAGREEMENT → VERIFICATION_PREREG: After root-cause analysis and repair, re-preregister with new tolerance (justified). Cannot proceed to TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY until MODEL_VERIFIED.

forbidden_transitions: MODEL_DISAGREEMENT → MODEL_VERIFIED without root-cause analysis and repair
VERIFICATION_RUNNING → MODEL_VERIFIED without preserving raw outputs
VERIFICATION_PREREGISTERED → MODEL_VERIFIED without running the comparison
